user_authorized_scope: Data list, historical-date requirements, upstream permission/coverage checks; design fixed tests only after data adequacy.
date_policy: First SSE session strictly after max(valid ann_date,f_ann_date), decision 15:00, execution next session. A proposed conservative date policy, not proof of vintage or vendor arrival.

preserve: update_flag without interpreting as PIT version

fixed_test_proposal.F1: quarter revenue YoY improvement AND quarter gross margin YoY improvement, zero cutoffs; parent-profit-only comparator
fixed_test_proposal.F2: YoY change in (quarter consolidated OCF - quarter consolidated net profit)/mean(begin-quarter,end-quarter consolidated assets); receivable/inventory change as competing explanations
fixed_test_proposal.population: all eligible financial disclosure/state update events, not restricted to old low-gap/up-close H3 cohort
fixed_test_proposal.independent_unit: report-period chains and same-date disclosure clusters
fixed_test_proposal.horizon_status: single proposed information-observation horizon; exact tradable label protocol to lock before computation; not optimizing holding days
fixed_test_proposal.F3: compare same-period final parent profit with latest previously known guidance interval; forecast units ten-thousand yuan, statement yuan
fixed_test_proposal.multiple_testing: no grids of windows or thresholds; all future configurations and outcomes disclosed

required_before_formal_research: Original-source core-field/vintage/date acceptance for all 27 statement periods; four summaries provide 16 reusable checks only, remaining 23 have no current spot-check.
DEV public dataset contract with explicit timing/quality semantics
public formal preparation and frozen label protocol

next_dev_proposal.changes: one dataset and focused tests; production unchanged

historical_version_scope: Default statement report_type=1 latest consolidated; adjusted/original type 4/5 not separately probed; duplicate rows not a complete revision chain.
